verdict.rationale: Letta's memory is stored as plain Markdown files in a Git-backed 'memory repository' (MemFS), and self-hosting keeps all agent state on-device with no proprietary lock-in, which implies inherent portability of memory data. However, there is no explicit documented export/import command, no described export file format spec, or CLI subcommand dedicated to exporting memories for migration — the pack only shows cloud backup/sync features, not a data-portability workflow. missing for 10: an explicit export/import command or documented export format, third-party confirmation that memory can be extracted and reloaded elsewhere, guidance on migrating memory out of Letta Cloud.
